# Button: `jl-button`

A button for actions, from the main one of a page to quiet ones in a toolbar.

- Class `JlButton`, an atom: `import { JlButton } from '@syware/jlib';`
- On the site: https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/components/button

Use primary for the one action a view is about, secondary (the default) for the others, ghost for
quiet actions in toolbars and lists, and danger for what destroys data.

Listen to press rather than click: it only fires while the button can be pressed, so a disabled or loading
button never runs its action. In a form, type="submit" and type="reset" act on the form around the button, even
across shadow roots.

Give it an href when it goes somewhere rather than does something: it becomes a real link with the same look, so a
middle click or Ctrl+click opens a new tab and the address shows on hover. press still fires. With download as
well, it saves what the address points to as a file of that name instead of opening it: an address of the page's own
site, or a data: or blob: URL, since browsers open the others.

## Use

```ts
import { JlButton } from '@syware/jlib';
```

```tsx
<JlButton label="Save changes" variant="primary" />
```

```html
<jl-button label="Save changes" variant="primary"></jl-button>
```

## Properties

Inputs: a JSX prop sets one, code calls `.set(value)` and `.get()`, HTML writes the attribute (lists and objects as JSON).

- `label` (attribute `label`): `string`, default `''`. The text.
- `variant` (attribute `variant`): `'secondary' | 'primary' | 'ghost' | 'danger'`, default `'secondary'`. The look, by importance.
- `size` (attribute `size`): `'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'`, default `'md'`. The height: 30, 36 or 44 pixels.
- `icon` (attribute `icon`): `string`, default `''`. An icon name, drawn before the label.
- `iconEnd` (attribute `icon-end`): `string`, default `''`. An icon name, drawn after the label.
- `hint` (attribute `hint`): `string`, default `''`. The tooltip, and the accessible name of a button with only an icon.
- `disabled` (attribute `disabled`): `boolean`, default `false`. Cannot be pressed.
- `loading` (attribute `loading`): `boolean`, default `false`. Shows a spinner and ignores presses.
- `block` (attribute `block`): `boolean`, default `false`. Takes the whole width.
- `href` (attribute `href`): `string`, default `''`. An address to open: the button becomes a link with the same look.
- `target` (attribute `target`): `string`, default `''`. Where the link opens, with an href: _blank for a new tab.
- `download` (attribute `download`): `string`, default `''`. With an href, saves what it points to as a file of this name instead of opening it: an address of the page's own site, data: or blob:.
- `type` (attribute `type`): `'button' | 'submit' | 'reset'`, default `'button'`. What it does in a form (not with an href).

## Events

In JSX, the `on…` prop, its handler given the detail; in code, `events.register(name, (detail) => …)`. They do not bubble.

- `press` (`onPress` in JSX), detail `undefined`: The button was pressed while enabled and not loading.

## Slots

- The default slot: Rich content for the label, when text is not enough.

## Methods

- `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void`: Focuses the button, or the link when it has an href.

## Styling

- `base` (part, `::part(base)`): The native button inside, or the link with an href.

## Examples

HTML as the site renders it, with its layout classes (`row`, `stack`, `narrow`, `muted`), which are not jlib's: a view writes the same components by class in JSX. A script's `root` is the example's element.

### Variants

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button variant="primary" label="Save changes"></jl-button>
  <jl-button label="Cancel"></jl-button>
  <jl-button variant="ghost" label="Learn more"></jl-button>
  <jl-button variant="danger" label="Delete"></jl-button>
</div>
```

### Sizes

sm in dense panels, md by default, lg where a thumb presses it.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button size="sm" label="Small"></jl-button>
  <jl-button label="Medium"></jl-button>
  <jl-button size="lg" label="Large"></jl-button>
</div>
```

### With icons

An icon before or after the label; with an icon alone, the hint names the button.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New project"></jl-button>
  <jl-button icon-end="arrow-right" label="Continue"></jl-button>
  <jl-button variant="ghost" icon="settings" hint="Settings"></jl-button>
  <jl-button icon="trash" hint="Delete" variant="danger"></jl-button>
</div>
```

### Loading and disabled

While loading, a spinner replaces the icon and presses are ignored.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button variant="primary" label="Saving" loading></jl-button>
  <jl-button label="Disabled" disabled></jl-button>
  <jl-button class="demo-load" icon="refresh" label="Press to load"></jl-button>
</div>
```

```js
const button = root.querySelector('.demo-load');
button.events.register('press', () => {
  button.loading.set(true);
  setTimeout(() => button.loading.set(false), 1500);
});
```

### As a link

With an href, a link that looks like a button. Disabled, it loses its address.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button variant="primary" icon="plus" label="New order" href="#new-order"></jl-button>
  <jl-button icon-end="external-link" label="Documentation" href="https://bioleyl.github.io/jlib/" target="_blank"></jl-button>
  <jl-button label="Archived" href="#archived" disabled></jl-button>
</div>
```

### Saving a file

With download, the link saves the file under that name. A file the server takes a while to make, or that can fail, takes download() of the toaster: its progress and errors show in a toast.

```html
<div class="row">
  <jl-button icon="download" label="Export as CSV" download="stock.csv"
    href="data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,sku%2Cstock%0AKB-104%2C12%0AMS-220%2C3"></jl-button>
</div>
```

### Full width

```html
<jl-button variant="primary" label="Create account" block></jl-button>
```
